snippet.description:
Learn partial fractions decomposition step by step with easy shortcut methods and integration rules. Master how to solve partial fraction problems quickly.

Is video me hum cover karenge Partial Fractions Decomposition ka complete concept bilkul simple aur easy bhasha me. Agar aap Class 11, Class 12, JEE, UG, PG ya Engineering Mathematics ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh ye topic aapke integration aur higher calculus ke liye sabse important foundation hai!

Is lecture me hum seekhenge:

What are Partial Fractions and why do we use them?
Proper vs Improper rational expressions
Linear factors, repeated factors, aur quadratic factors ko resolve karne ka step-by-step method
Integration by Partial Fractions solve karne ki best shortcuts aur tips

Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Series Overview
00:46 – Why Do We Need Partial Fractions? (Motivation & Integration)
03:52 – Polynomials & Rational Functions Explained
05:23 – Proper vs. Improper Rational Expressions
08:10 – Role of the Denominator & Factorization Concepts
10:02 – Case 1: Distinct Linear Factors
11:58 – Example 1: Solving Distinct Linear Factors Step-by-Step
17:40 – General Form for Distinct Linear Factors
19:22 – Case 2: Repeated Linear Factors
22:33 – Example 2: Step-by-Step Solution for Repeated Linear Factors
27:38 – Alternative Techniques: Comparing Coefficients vs. Substitution
32:50 – Case 3: Irreducible Quadratic Factors
34:25 – Example 3: Step-by-Step Decomposition with Quadratic Factors
40:44 – Case 4: Repeated Irreducible Quadratic Factors
44:06 – Higher-Degree Irreducible Factors (Cubic & General Forms)
46:41 – Substitution Shortcut Trick for Even Powers
48:15 – Summary & Other Applications (Integration, Infinite Series)

The PDF is available at  
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1M-qtVWirtandyQ4UrM3Svn1Y-9Mk5Htd/view?usp=drive_link
